summary: Central US Lookouts lists a Mark Twain National Forest lookout site in Laclede County; no build history or current condition found.

evidence.quote: Missouri Lookouts - Laclede County - Mark Twain National Forest - 34N-13W-5

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The Coon page on Central US Lookouts has a title and one location line, with no history text. Two web searches (Coon, Laclede County, Mark Twain) found no other Coon source, and the NHLR and FFLOS caches have no Coon page. The story is about 50 words, well under the roughly 120-word floor for thin evidence. Recommend holding it from publication until a source gives a build date, status and access. Agency and location rest on that one line and the record's own coordinates.
